interface.longDescription: Qarinah is evidence-linked project memory for coding agents - compact enough to save context, inspectable enough to trust. It captures explicitly permitted Codex lifecycle metadata into a local tamper-evident record. Read-only MCP tools report status and integrity; explicit local or Maqam-governed queries compile small cited context packs.
